summary: UploadJob and UploadJobs classes manage document uploads by users (Students, Staff) for agencies and departments within HSPnet, supporting searching, adding, deleting, marking as processed/rejected, and retrieval. They track metadata, workflow, and validation for uploaded files.
purpose: To facilitate secure and organized uploading, searching, management, and retrieval of documents by staff and students, with business rules for file handling, validation, and workflow state tracking in the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Upload Document Workflow
steps: User initiates an UploadJob with relevant metadata and file
If valid, Insert into database using UploadJobAdd procedure
Linked with agency, department, program, cohort, term, course, and optionally student consent
User may retrieve or search UploadJobs by parameters
Admins/authorized users may mark UploadJobs as processed or rejected
File deletion and database cleanup handled by Delete operation

workflows.name: Search Workflow
steps: User/actor initiates search using UploadJobSearch, UploadJobSearchAgencies, or UploadJobSearchUsers
System executes corresponding stored procedure and returns matched UploadJob records
Entities and fields are enriched from database
Display includes links, formatted names, phone, email

business_rules: FileURL and FilePath cannot be blank.
FileType 0/-1 is valid, no document yet; handled by upload proc.
Deletion ignores exceptions if file/folder delete fails.
Files are associated with agency, department, program, cohort, term, course, and consent program if applicable.
validations: FileURL and FilePath must not be empty
UploadType value is restricted to valid types
File existence checked when displaying link
Comments may be enriched and must be translated to HTML if necessary
calculations: File size converted to kilobytes for display
Name formatting for UI using NameFormatter.FormatName
Date formatting for UI using DateFormatter.FormatDateShort
conditions: If file does not exist, FileURL returns 'Document_Not_Found'.
If department, program, cohort, term, course fields not empty, enrich Department display string.
system_behavior: Search and retrieval using stored procedures
Delete operation removes file/folder and DB record; exceptions ignored
Add operation only proceeds if validations pass
dependencies: Database stored procedures: UploadJobAdd, UploadJobSearch, UploadJobDelete, UploadJobSearchAgencies, UploadJobSearchUsers, UploadJobMarkProcessed, UploadJobMarkRejected
exceptions: File or directory delete failure ignored
Invalid upload file type triggers messages, upload rejected
